searchText: Hi everybody I'm really new to cryptocurrency and I want to know if there's any wallets for Eth such as yoroi for cardano. In solidity, you write in solidity and it compiles to evm bytecode Not really, it's a standard. There are changes you're allowed to do while following the standard Otherwise you can write contracts that don't follow the standard <@!291925846556540928> <@!488328812501663744> Could you tell me how can i find ERC20 and ERC721 contract address in main net? ERC20 is a standard for contracts not a contract in itself. For instance here is the DAI ERC20 contract. https://etherscan.io/address/0x6b175474e89094c44da98b954eedeac495271d0f#code Much appriciate for your kind suggestion. <@!488328812501663744> May i tell you my idea if it can be implemented?
